entry.summary: Expect 90 to 130 mm of rain. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h expected, mainly from 6am. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale northwest winds gusting 120 km/h in exposed places, but damaging gusts of 140 km/h possible in exposed parts of the High Country. Note, winds easing from the south from tonight. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 60 to 100 mm of rain about the ranges. This is in addition to the rain that has already fallen. Coastal areas may only get additional 20 to 40 mm of rain during this period, but brief high intensity rainfall there could still cause impacts. Peak rates of 25 to 35 mm/h expected, mainly about the ranges. Note, rain easing from the south from tonight. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 60 to 100 mm of rain about the main divide, and 40 to 60 mm within 20 km farther east. Peak rates of 25 to 35 mm/h expected about the divide. Freezing level about 3000 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
